literal_implementation_verification.requirement: test the existing production implementation literally

L1_get_fast_bias.method: vectorised rule compared against bias_engine.get_fast_bias called on real H1 slices

displacement_detect_displacement_candle.method: vectorised rule compared against entry_engine.detect_displacement_candle on real M15 slices

L2_get_h1_structure.method: production function called directly per H1 bar, not reimplemented
L2_get_h1_structure.calls: one per eligible H1 bar over TRAIN+DEV

literal_implementation_verification.documented_deviation: detect_displacement_candle is called with M15 rather than the production M5, because the authorised primary timeframe for this audit is M15. The function body is timeframe-agnostic. Input frame changed; rule and thresholds unchanged. Declared in the frozen hypothesis before results existed.

overlap_ratios.note: B family is far less overlapped (1.5-3.3x) because displacement is rare

statistical_guardrails.sign_disagreement_note: 5 of 9 cells show the equal-block statistic disagreeing in sign with the raw mean. None is a headline; the headline is non-overlapping throughout.

direction_conditioned.A_degenerate: A_bias_alone IS the direction-conditioned population, so its excess is 0.0000 by construction -- a degenerate comparison, stated rather than presented as a null result. A is tested against the unconditional mean.
direction_conditioned.reading: displacement and structure confirmation SUBTRACT from bias alone at every horizon

displacement_conditioned.reading: no family adds information beyond recent directional movement

temporal_instability.reading: sign flips across quarters; reported as instability, no period selected

h1_regime_finding.status: SECONDARY by the frozen specification -- not counted as discovery, not used to select
h1_regime_finding.interpretation: Direction-normalised continuation is POSITIVE in H1 uptrends and NEGATIVE in H1 downtrends. Genuine continuation would be positive in both, since the return is already signed by the predicted direction. A pattern that works long and fails short in a sample whose three arms are all net-positive (+33.6 / +44.2 / +18.2 percent) is the signature of DRIFT, not of a continuation mechanism.

bias_strength_finding.interpretation: Continuation does NOT increase with bias_strength; the point estimates run the other way. The production confidence model weights bias_strength and the A+ checklist requires strength >= 8.0, so this is directly relevant to the architecture, though no cell is significant.

cost_gate.reason: no family produced a positive gross effect surviving the corrected threshold

power_disclosure.note: the 4h confidence interval's upper bound only just exceeds the cost threshold, so a cost-relevant effect is not excluded -- which is why family A is INCONCLUSIVE rather than NOT SUPPORTED

no_feature_search: exactly the 9 pre-declared hypotheses were tested. No new predictor was introduced, no threshold chosen or tuned, no strategy constructed.
